node.title: N=256 square-mass-16 autocorrelation-subfield exclusion
node.statement: For a profile-(3,4,0) N=256,s=5 candidate at variance V=76, the exact slack recurrence gives L<=22 and conjugate squares at most 60. If A_d=0 whenever 4 does not divide d, then beta=F(zeta)conjugate(F(zeta)) lies in Q(zeta_64). Writing R=Norm_Q(zeta_256)(F(zeta)) and N=Norm_Q(zeta_64)(beta), the tower law gives R^2=N^4 while 0<|N|<=60^32<2^250. Hence no pair-feasible row prime divides R. Every live V=76 candidate has a nonzero autocorrelation distance not divisible by four.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: removes the subgroup-concentrated weighted-third-moment extremizer from the V=76 route. The nonperiodic variance-76 residual remains open.
